recentItems.title: Chiara Ferragni: Front Facing | Official Trailer | Netflix
recentItems.description:
For years she shared her life with millions of people, but never what happened once the cameras were off. After two years of silence, Chiara Ferragni tells her story, revisiting her darkest period, when everything fell apart: from the “Pandoro Gate” scandal to the trial and the end of her fairytale marriage. A pioneer of influencer culture, she started out in small-town Italy and became a global brand. Now she looks back and tells her story, this time unfiltered.

Chiara Ferragni: Front facing, is coming only on Netflix on November 23.

Watch on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/title/82708099

recentItems.title: Emei | The Understudy (From “STEPS”) | Lyric Video | Netflix
recentItems.description:
If you want to hear Lilith’s “walk-up song,” hit play on Emei’s, “The Understudy” and check out the official lyric video from the STEPS soundtrack. STEPS is now playing, only on Netflix.

Listen and Download “The Understudy” (from STEPS) out now: https://netflixmusic.ffm.to/theunderstudy

The STEPS soundtrack is available everywhere: https://netflixmusic.ffm.to/steps

About STEPS:
Think you know Cinderella’s “evil” stepsisters? Think again. Tired of living in Cinderella’s shadow, Lilith (Ali Wong) steals the Fairy Godmother (Bette Midler)’s magic wand and hijacks the Royal Ball with her sister Margot (Stephanie Hsu), breaking the Cinderella story as we know it and dooming the kingdom to the tyrannical rule of Priscilla (Nikki Glaser), a villainous schemer who swoops in and snatches the throne. Now, Lilith must team up with Cinderella (Amanda Seyfried) to fight biker trolls, outrun evil henchmen, and escape the Screaming Woods on an epic quest to save the kingdom, but most importantly, their relationship. STEPS is directed by Alyce Tzue and John Ripa, produced by Jane Hartwell, and Amy Poehler and Kim Lessing for Paper Kite Productions.
